author: independent education critic (non-author Claude subagent, 2026-11-19; head 3c2ea6a9)
summary: Three-activity cumulative review with confidence-rated MCQs and one predict item per page; distractors map to taught misconceptions and every option explains itself; objectives match the checks; 15-minute budget is a modelled figure labelled as such; DESIGN anatomy (topic bar, timeline, fit, task, success list, hints, recap, cheat sheet, sources) present. Only low residuals.

findings.claim: Objectives and prerequisites list debugging-with-logs-and-exec but nothing on the page asks the learner to use exec or logs beyond reading one log line; coverage of that taught topic is thin.
findings.recommendation: Accept as recorded residual: the page maps no curriculum row and its three objectives are honest; exec practice stays in the module lab.

findings.claim: The fit decision (when to add a second stage) is answered by the page itself; the question that follows presumes the answer, so the block adds little retrieval value.
findings.recommendation: Accept as recorded residual: it is teaching framing, not a check.
